metric: balanced accuracy on the test split, in points, one decimal as published
threshold_rule: No threshold is tuned. The leaderboard states that systems are benchmarked in a zero-shot fashion (https://llm-aggrefact.github.io/blog). The benchmark's paper (Tang, Laban and Durrett, MiniCheck, EMNLP 2024, section 4.1) sets the threshold at the midpoint of the output score range, 0.5 for most fact-checkers, and the official evaluation notebook (benchmark_evaluation_demo.ipynb of github.com/Liyan06/MiniCheck) converts the raw probability into a label with the threshold 0.5.
not_documented: How each entry was run: the leaderboard does not say how HHEM-2.1-open handled its longest inputs, nor whether a score equal to 0.5 counts as supported.
